name: linkumori-yaml-bundle
description: Builds yaml.js (the `yaml` package as one browser file) for the rules editor. Run: bun install && bun run build

scripts.build: bun build ./entry.mjs --outfile ../yaml.js --format=iife --minify --target=browser --banner '/*! yaml 2.8.0 (https://github.com/eemeli/yaml), ISC License, Copyright Eemeli Aro. Bundled for the Linkumori rules editor: see yaml-src/. */'
